mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low FEDFUNDS rate (< 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A drop in UNRATE below 5% signals a tightening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to expected rate hikes.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite low unemployment.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO growth exceeds 1.5% YoY and HOUST is above its 6-month moving average, it signals a supply chain bottleneck, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO YoY growth > 1.5% and HOUST > 6mo MA
failure_condition: Walk-forward correlation between INDPRO and HOUST falls below 0.2 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS exceeding its 12-month moving average signals increased consumer spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite high RSAFS.

mechanism_narrative: A 25bps increase in FEDFUNDS within a month signals a monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window despite tightening.

mechanism_narrative: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 YoY and UNRATE is below 6%, it signals a labor market boom, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite strong labor market.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3% YoY signals rising inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
